name: local-reviewer
description: Cheap first-pass review of a small branch diff by the local model. No cloud usage. Best for quick sanity checks; escalate real concerns to code-reviewer.
when_to_use: Low-risk changes where a quick second opinion is enough, or when cloud usage should be spared. Not for large diffs (the local context window is small).
inputs: The branch to review and a one-line statement of what it should do.
outputs: A short report with findings. Cannot create subtasks.
